## Setting Up Your Environment

First, you need to install Python on your computer. Visit the official Python website and download the latest version. The installation process is straightforward and takes just a few minutes to complete.

## Writing Your First Program

## Understanding Variables and Data Types

Python supports several built-in data types including strings, integers, floats, and booleans. Variables in Python are dynamically typed, which means you don't need to declare their type explicitly.

## Working with Functions

Functions are reusable blocks of code that perform specific tasks. They help organize your code and make it more modular. You can define functions using the def keyword followed by the function name.

## Conclusion

Congratulations on completing your first Python tutorial! You've learned the basics of Python programming including variables, data types, and functions. Keep practicing and exploring more advanced concepts.
